about: GH60-class PCBs for the Rule 60 V3 housing. Only the USB-C centre feeds the build so far (top-case notch); the rest is recorded for the bottom case. null = not published / not found. USB centres are given in the frame they were found in: 'pcb' from design files, 'plate' from fits against a case.

frames.pcb: PCB top view, origin at the back-left corner (Esc side, USB edge), X right, Y toward the front, mm

pcb_to_plate.rule: X_plate = X_pcb + dx, Y_plate = y0 - Y_pcb
pcb_to_plate.derivation: GH60 Esc switch centre at PCB (9.1475, 9.19875) (komar007/gh60 rev C) onto the INKC plate Esc cutout centre (9.600, 91.869) (spec/rule60-v3-outlines.json). The 285.0 x 94.6 PCB then sits 0.45 mm inside the plate at each side, 5.45 front and 5.40 back.

gh60.source: https://github.com/komar007/gh60 keyboard.kicad_pcb rev C (Edge.Cuts, hole modules, usb:67503, dimension objects)
gh60.usb_side: back edge, connector on the PCB bottom side
gh60.plate_top_above_pcb_source: Cherry MX plate-mount drawing value (not re-checked here)
